TRACE and MCP.title: Verify TRACE MCP transport and add health probe route
TRACE and MCP.why: TRACE MCP is the canonical retrieval boundary and must be routinely health-checked.
TRACE and MCP.action: Add a lightweight GET /health endpoint that proxies a TRACE MCP tools/list call and fails fast if TRACE is unreachable.

Atlas Overlay.title: Wire schema-indexer contract into MCP search routing
Atlas Overlay.why: schema-indexer contract cards exist but no MCP tool or route reads them for query routing.
Atlas Overlay.action: Implement a TRACE MCP tool or HTTP GET /api/atlas/schema-search that queries memory/knowledge/schema-indexer-contract-cards.jsonl and returns top candidates.

Vector Drift.title: Add 768d shadow pgvector columns and backfill
Vector Drift.why: Live DB uses 384d vectors but retrieval expects 768d - add shadow columns to migrate safely.
Vector Drift.action: Create migration SQL to add vector(768) shadow columns, backfill from embeddings pipeline, and route retrieval to preferred column.

Cluster Cards.title: Generate cluster cards after codebase map stabilizes
Cluster Cards.why: Cluster card flow depends on stable codebase map; automation should run post-graph export.
Cluster Cards.action: Run `npm run graphify:cluster-summaries` and write graph-refresh manifest; add a manifest version write step to export pipeline.

Agent Executor.title: Implement runAgentSkill via TRACE MCP
Agent Executor.why: Agent executor route is a 501 stub; implement minimal runtime to call trace.kag_search and return top-5.
Agent Executor.action: Implement `sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/agent-executor.ts` to call TRACE MCP and hook into /api/atlas/audit route.

Phase Catch-up.title: Prime engram session context on startup
Phase Catch-up.why: engram.session_context_inject must be called from workspace-bootstrap to warm KV cache.
Phase Catch-up.action: Call engram.session_context_inject in antigravity agent prompt flow and verify in startup smoke.
